 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is second repeat bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant.
His First application (Misc. Cri. Case No. 60834/2022) was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 14.03.2023.

T he applicant is in custody since 26/9/2022 in connection with Crime No.472/2022 registered at Police Station Kampoo, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 363,
368 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text:
As per prosecution story, on 23.09.2022 when prosecutrix was going to market for shopping,
present applicant Shivam Tomar met her on the way and gave her lift on his bike, thereafter he took her to Kartar Hotel, where in Room No. 108 he is alleged to have committed offence of rape with the prosecutrix and threatened her not to lodge any report.
Accordingly case was registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated.
He has no criminal antecedents.

In the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of CrPC as well as in the statement recorded before the trial Court, there is vast variation and unrealistic improvement as regards alleged incident.
Investigation has been completed, challan has been filed and all the material witnesses including the prosecutrix have been examined.
The applicant has already suffered jail incarceration since 26/9/2022.
As the investigation is complete, he is no more required for custodial interrogation.

Co-accused Sparsh has already been extended benefit of regular bail vide order dated 28.11.2022 passed in MCRC No.
55005/2022.
The applicant is ready and willing to abide by such terms and conditions as may be deemed fit and proper for his enlargement on bail.
Trial is not likely to be concluded early in near future.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
P er contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposes the bail application supporting the order impugned.

Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties though this Court reference from commenting upon the rival contentions touching merits of the case, but regard being had to the fact that the applicant who has no criminal antecedent is in custody since 26/9/2022, investigation is complete, challan has been filed and material witnesses including the prosecutrix have already been examined, in the obtaining facts and circumstances, this Court is of the view that the applicant is held entitled to be enlarged on bail but with certain stringent conditions.
Consequently, the application of the applicant filed under Section 439 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 is hereby allowed.

It is directed that present applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court and on the condition that he shall remain present before the Court concerned during trial and also comply with the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 with following further conditions:
( i ) the applicant shall mark his attendance before the concerned police station on second and fourth Saturday every month between 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon.
(ii) on violation of conditions, State is free to apply for cancellation of bail.

(iii) in future, if the applicant is found to be involved in such nature o f cases or any other similar criminal cases or misuses the bail granted by this Court, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically.
